fork_latest_release.name: SHVIA 1.2.43 (Strix 1.7.0)
fork_latest_release.body:
**Fork version** `1.2.43` · based on upstream `1.7.0` + 14 commits (`62b4964`) · pull request #37

The engine ships as **Pentest**: four standalone binaries on this Release, named `pentest-<rust-target-triple>`, with their `SHA256SUMS`, so the ShvIA Desktop can bundle them in its installer (Desktop 1.32.0 pins them by SHA-256). The report PDF prints `SHVIA / PENTEST` on its cover and `SHVIA Pentest` as its author.

**Where the binaries come from.** GitHub Actions is locked for this account since 26/10/2026, so `pentest-binaries.yml` could not build and attach them for this tag. They were attached by hand from that workflow's run [39984194123](https://github.com/samirhvbr/strix/actions/runs/39984194123) of 23/10/2026, built from `047cc8cb` on the branch of #37, where each binary answered `--fork-version` with `1.2.43` on its own platform. The two commits after it change the workflow, the docs, a test and `strix/report/package_pdf.py`, the server-side PDF renderer the engine binary does not run. The Linux x86_64 binary was run again on 27/10/2026 and answers `1.2.43`. Not exercised: a real scan, and a macOS binary inside the Desktop's signed app.

| File | SHA-256 |
|---|---|
| `pentest-aarch64-apple-darwin` | `c07aff3841e7b6a070fffd6a6d8e1cbcde489a541f033d46e9bd0c68e15e124d` |
| `pentest-x86_64-apple-darwin` | `a7987552bdcb75e83ae6098f27e463b0d2a8d1d5df55580814e4e752bab3e09b` |
| `pentest-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu` | `73aa556f81807951720d9ac19b6af0232aa96804f1111d4fd2403d953d073a07` |
| `pentest-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu` | `8dd0bcdbb91982ea4a818db8ca84eb3e5577218f948477c5287787760a030b00` |

The WEB server's copy of `package_pdf.py` has to be copied again to print the new cover (`docs/PENTEST/report-pdf.md`).

sandbox_image_audit.method: Anonymous pull token, then manifest and tags/list requests. 1.3.0 answering 200 is the positive control for the token.
sandbox_image_audit.implication: A scan or an engine binary built from the review branch cannot pull its default sandbox image until 1.3.1 exists in the registry; STRIX_IMAGE can override it. Delivering the synchronization to master without resolving this would break the default runtime.
sandbox_image_audit.tradeoff: Pinning 1.3.0 keeps the runtime working but leaves libbrotli 1.2.0-4 (CVE-2026-111497) in the image used against hostile targets.
sandbox_image_audit.decision: Pinned to 1.3.0 on the delivery branch feat/upstream-sync-delivery-20261029 (RuntimeSettings.image and scripts/install.sh, kept equal by a test). The host-side tools and caido_api.py are unchanged between the two images; the Dockerfile and entrypoint differ only by the brotli patch, trufflehog 3.99.2 and the #1499 NSS restart guard, so the engine runs against 1.3.0 and the brotli CVE stays unpatched in the image until 1.3.1 is published. Revisit: when `manifest inspect` finds 1.3.1, move both pins and drop this note.
